component.name: HandShaker for Linux
component.summary: Open-source Linux client for the Smartisan HandShaker Android protocol

description.p: Manage files, photos, videos, music, and synced clipboard items on an Android phone running the Smartisan HandShaker APK over Wi-Fi (mDNS) or direct USB Open Accessory (AOA), with native Wayland/Hyprland ergonomics, CLI tools, and optional FUSE filesystem mounting.
